item.title: Introducing Continue reading: a calm e-book reader for the library you already have
item.description: For years my books have lived in Calibre. It is the best tool there is for keeping a library: metadata, covers, formats, tags, series, all in one place. But reading from it has always been awkward. I’d send a book to one device, read a few chapters, pick up another device, and start hunting for my page. Highlights stayed wherever I made them. My reading history was scattered across apps that each wanted their own account and their own copy of my books.
